purpose: Keep Agent Runtime substrate/platform proof separate from native InfRing intelligence proof so external framework success cannot accidentally promote native coding capability.

ledgers.counts_as: InfRing can host, constrain, normalize, approve, resume, score, and observe native or external engines through Gateway.
ledgers.does_not_count_as: Infring-native coding intelligence or native workflow usefulness when the primary worker is an external framework.
required_evidence: compact proof summaries with not_native_intelligence_proof=true for external-engine rows
Gateway approval/resume and artifact verification evidence
engine scorecard or task harness evidence that records framework_id

ledgers.counts_as: InfRing-native workflows, tools, memory, receipts, provider routing, and native file/command surfaces perform useful software work.
ledgers.does_not_count_as: External framework capability, even when mediated cleanly through InfRing.

invariants: External-engine mediated success is substrate/platform proof, not native intelligence proof.
Native coding promotion requires Infring-native worker evidence and the 19/20 useful-work target.

Codex, Claude Code, Grok Code, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Hermes, OpenHands, OpenFang, and custom external engines may validate harness shape, prompts, or judges, but do not prove native InfRing coding capability.
Any proof summary that includes external framework rows must explicitly mark not_native_intelligence_proof=true.
